problems.description:
The three reviewers converged on a single high-severity issue in
`scripts/verification_log_append.py:280`. The `_check_agent` function enforces
required keys but never rejects unknown keys, unlike `_check_top_level` which
mirrors the `ALLOWED_TOP` whitelist. All three agents flagged this as a
direct inconsistency that should be fixed by mirroring the pattern.

Two reviewers pointed out that in `scripts/verification_log_build_input.py:555`
the expression `f"{max(1,N-2)}/{N}"` produces the wrong label `"1/3"` when
`N=3`, while the consolidator prompt defines LIKELY as 2/3. The fix is an
explicit `AGREEMENT_LABELS` lookup table.

One reviewer noted that IsaacLab projects typically place tests under
`source/<package>/test/`, so the proposed top-level `tests/` directory may
conflict with convention. Either relocate or amend §10.

---
